_doc: Dated, reviewed exceptions for guardrails.py fact rules (app-size, app-type) on one file each; read by guardrails.excepted at the pushed head. Fields and receipt as arch-ratchet.json's exceptions; an expired or self-reviewed entry allows nothing.

exceptions.why: cmux#28111 (cloud.startChat, Leo 2026-10-30: "like the initial 0 to 1 chat auto it sends to cloud"): a new App file. It drives CloudService, CloudMove, the machine store and the agent tabs, which all live in CmuxNextApp today, so no domain package can hold it without moving those first. Its logic (the machine pick, the per-send ledger, the account checks) moves to acpmux/cmux-tui in the cloud.startChat Rust move, which deletes this file; the same reason as its app_lines entry in arch-ratchet.json.

exceptions.why: cmux#36846: a new App file for the same reviewed reason as its app_lines entry in plans/cmux-next/arch-exceptions/relay-chat-harness-login.json. cloud relay-chat runs the start-session harness login step before the relay send (Leo: "we have the daemon, we have the token, we have the thing that can just send it over the authentication ... just fix it"). The App part is the binding over App-only types (AppActionContext, CloudHandlers, CloudStartSession, CloudMachineSession.harnessLogin): the login step before relay.chat/relay.answer, its 15 s share of the result deadline, the typed undelivered refusals and their four localized strings; the login rules stay in Rust (cmux-cloud-start-core) and CmuxNextCloudCredentials, the relay stream in CmuxNextCloud.
